frozen_at: 2026-10-23, before any run of these arms beyond 3-task smoke tests
purpose: separate the repair INTERFACE from (a) a stronger model choosing the action and (b) unequal information in the WM prompts
planner: 4B; WM / takeover model = Qwen3-14B (wm_alt, thinking off); gate = a_base not admissible (same as frozen method)

new_arms.inv_takeover: 14B decides directly with the planner's own v2 prompt + FAIL_BLOCK (no diagnosis format)
new_arms.inv_wmrepair_reason: same WM call as the frozen method, planner shown the reason only
new_arms.inv_wmrepair_action: same WM call, planner shown the suggested first step only (no reason)
new_arms.inv_wmpred_info: next-observation prediction with the same information as the repair prompt (valid actions + 'not in the valid list')

primary_fresh600_holm_PR.C1: wmrepair_wm14 - inv_takeover (does asking for a diagnosis beat letting the 14B model act?)
primary_fresh600_holm_PR.C3: wmrepair_reason - inv_fail (does the reason alone add value?)

interpretation.gain mostly 'stronger model acts': C1 not significant or < 0: report the repair interface as a way to use a stronger model at failure steps, not as an independent effect
interpretation.reason carries information: C3 > 0; if only the action-only arm works, the value is the suggested action, not the diagnosis

test: paired task bootstrap 20k on rep-averaged per-task values, two-sided, Holm within the primary family
